mapper.select: SELECT EMPNO, ACCESS_TOKEN, REFRESH_TOKEN FROM EMP_KAKAO
SELECT EMPNO, ACCESS_TOKEN, REFRESH_TOKEN FROM EMP_KAKAO WHERE EMPNO = #{empno}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO EMP_KAKAO ek USING DUAL ON (ek.EMPNO = #{empno}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ek.ACCESS_TOKEN = #{accessToken}, ek.REFRESH_TOKEN = #{refreshToken}, ek.UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (EMPNO, ACCESS_TOKEN, REFRESH_TOKEN, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{empno}, #{accessToken}, #{refreshToken}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE EMP_KAKAO SET ACCESS_TOKEN = #{accessToken}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE EMPNO = #{empno}
mapper.select: SELECT e.EMPNO AS "empno", e.ENAME AS "ename" FROM EMP e INNER JOIN EMP_KAKAO ek ON e.EMPNO = ek.EMPNO ORDER BY e.ENAME
SELECT e.EMPNO AS "empno", e.ENAME AS "ename" FROM EMP e WHERE e.EMPNO NOT IN (SELECT ek.EMPNO FROM EMP_KAKAO ek) ORDER BY e.ENAME
